instruction: Change GIMP's interface theme to gray.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GIMP's theme setting to 'Gray'. Evaluator uses existing check_config_status metric to verify the 'theme' key in gimprc is set to 'Gray'. This is another theme variation with the same complexity as the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: switching GIMP's theme to 'Gray'
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to ensure config changes are written to disk
Getter (get_gimp_config_file) correctly retrieves the gimprc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric (check_config_status) correctly parses gimprc format and checks key-value pairs: theme="Gray"
Expected value correctly specifies 'Gray' with proper quoting to match gimprc format: (theme "Gray")
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements are verified
Logic handles edge cases: skips comments and empty lines, supports both single and multi-part config keys
